sources.summary: Inspired by an ephemeral bliss experienced in a South Indian temple complex, this moment is poetic, a setting sun visually diminishing the density of the stone, creating an intangible relationship with the material. Bangalore and Karnataka's association with chapdi (local and natural stone slabs 100mm thickness) has been eternal, yet the dignity it has obtained for its aesthetic and structural properties remains underexplored.
